visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Wrong Starting Values
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The sequence should start 0 1 1 2 3 5 8 13, but the program prints 1 1 2 3 5 8 13 21.

solution.explanation: fib(0) must be 0, so the pair starts as (0, 1). Starting at (1, 1) shifts the whole sequence by one place, which skips the leading 0.
